name: an in-place preview job refused by the first collision check before preparation: the record is eligibility with previewFailure, start reports and mutates nothing, and a fresh APPROVE after the collision clears prepares and switches without a manual branch switch
scenario: Main renames old/ to new/ while the job adds old/extra.json. Directory renames are enabled, so the merge relocates the job file to new/extra.json. An ignored local file already sits at new/extra.json in the in-place checkout, which is on factory/007-cfg.

events.effect: fresh APPROVE: checks (a) to (c) pass from the pinned job SHA
first collision check before the in-place switch and set-aside: refused on new/extra.json
previewStep eligibility with previewFailure {step eligibility, blocking paths}; no previewBase, no switch, no set-aside
reports the refusal and mutates nothing; eligibility is not re-run
moves the ignored local file out of the way
rework retires the attempt (the eligibility row allows rework)
a fresh APPROVE enters eligibility; the preparation check passes
git switch --no-overwrite-ignore main, run by the procedure with no operator action
previewBase persisted with previewStep prepare, before the switch
collision check again immediately before the merge
git merge --no-ff --no-overwrite-ignore factory/007-cfg succeeds and relocates the job file
